entries.title: Acts 11:1
segments: ¶Now the Apostles and the brothers who were in Judaea had news that the word of God had been given to the Gentiles.

entries.title: Acts 11:2
segments: And when Peter came to Jerusalem, those who kept the rule of circumcision had an argument with him,

entries.title: Acts 11:3
segments: Saying, You went to men without circumcision, and took food with them.

entries.title: Acts 11:4
segments: But Peter gave them an account of it all in order, saying to them,

entries.title: Acts 11:5
segments: I was in the town of Joppa, at prayer: and falling into a deep sleep, I saw in a vision a vessel like a great cloth let down from heaven, and it came down to me:

entries.title: Acts 11:6
segments: And looking on it with attention I saw in it all sorts of beasts and birds.

entries.title: Acts 11:7
segments: And a voice came to my ears saying, Come, Peter; take them for food.

entries.title: Acts 11:8
segments: But I said, No, Lord; for nothing common or unclean has ever come into my mouth.

entries.title: Acts 11:9
segments: But the voice, coming a second time from heaven, said, What God has made clean, do not you make common.

entries.title: Acts 11:10
segments: And this was done three times, and they were all taken up again into heaven.

entries.title: Acts 11:11
segments: And at that minute, three men, sent from Caesarea, came to the house where we were.

entries.title: Acts 11:12
segments: And the Spirit gave me orders to go with them, doubting nothing. And these six brothers came with me; and we went into that man's house:

entries.title: Acts 11:13
segments: And he gave us an account of how he had seen the angel in his house, saying, Send to Joppa, and get Simon, named Peter, to come to you;

entries.title: Acts 11:14
segments: Who will say words to you through which you and all your family may get salvation.

entries.title: Acts 11:15
segments: And, while I was talking to them, the Holy Spirit came on them, as on us at first.

entries.title: Acts 11:16
segments: And the words of the Lord came into my mind, how he said, The baptism of John was with water, but you will have baptism with the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Acts 11:17
segments: If then God gave them, when they had faith in the Lord Jesus Christ, the same as he gave to us, who was I to go against God?

entries.title: Acts 11:18
segments: And hearing these things they said nothing more, but gave glory to God, saying, Then to the Gentiles as to us has God given a change of heart, so that they may have life.

entries.title: Acts 11:19
segments: ¶Then those who had gone away at the time of the trouble about Stephen, went as far as Phoenicia and Cyprus, preaching to the Jews only.

entries.title: Acts 11:20
segments: But some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, when they came to Antioch, gave the good news about the Lord Jesus to the Greeks.

entries.title: Acts 11:21
segments: And the power of the Lord was with them, and a great number had faith and were turned to the Lord.

entries.title: Acts 11:22
segments: And news of them came to the ears of the church at Jerusalem: and they sent Barnabas as far as Antioch:

entries.title: Acts 11:23
segments: Who, when he came and saw the grace of God, was glad; and he made clear to them the need of keeping near the Lord with all the strength of their hearts:

entries.title: Acts 11:24
segments: For he was a good man and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith: and a great number were joined to the Lord.

entries.title: Acts 11:25
segments: Then he went on to Tarsus, looking for Saul;

entries.title: Acts 11:26
segments: And when he had come across him, he took him to Antioch. And they were with the church there for a year, teaching the people; and the disciples were first given the name of Christians in Antioch.

entries.title: Acts 11:27
segments: ¶Now in those days prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch.

entries.title: Acts 11:28
segments: And one of them, named Agabus, said publicly through the Spirit that there would be serious need of food all over the earth: which came about in the time of Claudius.

entries.title: Acts 11:29
segments: And the disciples, everyone as he was able, made a decision to send help to the brothers living in Judaea:

entries.title: Acts 11:30
segments: Which they did, sending it to the rulers of the church by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.
